title: Kelvin Opens The Link (Wow Friend)
style: warm latin folk-pop, 96 bpm, 336 hz subharmonic, nylon guitar, soft cajon, gentle whistle, friendly bilingual hum, no real names sung
lyrics:
[Intro]
text comes in at ten oh five
friend says wow, link looks alive

[Verse 1]
spanish question, gentle and kind
is it music? is it a find?
an app to play tracks one by one?
or something else, something fun?

[Pre-Chorus]
but the tunnel slept, the tunnel went
so the friend just sees an empty tent

[Chorus]
wow friend, wow friend
the link you opened hit a dead end
not your fault, not the wire
ephemeral host just retired
wow friend, wow friend
we rebuild it, we ascend

[Verse 2]
respond simple, respond clear
tunnel was demo, not for here
next time pinned to a real address
then we share, then we progress

[Chorus]
wow friend, wow friend
the link you opened hit a dead end
not your fault, not the wire
ephemeral host just retired
wow friend, wow friend
we rebuild it, we ascend

[Outro]
happy hardcore smiling joy
friendship bigger than a broken toy
